# Owner approval form — pilot launch gate (2026-09-09)

This form is the explicit human sign-off gate for the three pilot places (VinWonders Phu Quoc,
Sun World Hon Thom, Vinpearl Safari Phu Quoc). Nothing in this package changes `verification_status`,
imports anything to staging or production, or opens an import queue by itself — see
`proposed-staging-import-plan.md` for what a later, separately-approved task would do.

**This document being generated by Claude is NOT an approval of anything in it.** Every decision
field below is intentionally left blank. Fill in one row per field, per place, and sign at the
bottom of each place's section.

For full context per field (evidence source, hash, capture date, Claude's recommendation) see the
matching row in `vinwonders-field-review.csv` / `hon-thom-field-review.csv` / `safari-field-review.csv`.

Decision values: `APPROVE` | `REJECT` | `NEEDS_CHANGES` | `DEFER`
